label: Lip-Sync Video
description: Turn a still picture of a person or character into a video of them speaking an audio track, made by Creatify Aurora through ElevenLabs. If you set something the model does not take, the call is refused before anything is charged. Needs your own ElevenLabs account on a Pro plan or above.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Your own ElevenLabs account: wire an ElevenLabsAccess node whose connection has "Images and video" ticked. weft's built-in connection cannot make images or videos, and each one is paid from this account's credits.

inputs.name: image
inputs.description: A picture of the person or character who speaks.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: Creatify Aurora, the only lip-sync model ElevenLabs's API serves.

inputs.name: guidanceScale
inputs.label: Picture guidance
inputs.description: How closely the video keeps to the picture, from 0 to 5. Leave empty for the model's default.

inputs.name: audioGuidanceScale
inputs.label: Audio guidance
inputs.description: How closely the lips follow the audio, from 0 to 5. Leave empty for the model's default.

outputs.name: video
outputs.description: The generated video, stored with the run and deleted with it (once the run's record goes); wire it through KeepFile to keep it past that.
